scripts.text:
Secret Passage to ^25C18DNinja Guild^25C18D
You hear familiar voices talking to each other.
scripts.translation:
通往^25C18D忍者公會^25C18D的秘密通道
你聽到熟悉的聲音在交談。

scripts.text:
[Unknown Voice A]
Long time, no see. How are you? How are the kids you've taken in?
scripts.translation:
[未知聲音 A]
好久不見。你最近怎麼樣？你收留的那些小孩還好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Unknown Voice B]
I have to hand it to you. You've picked some competitive ones.
scripts.translation:
[未知聲音 B]
不得不承認，你挑的人很有競爭力。

scripts.text:
[Unknown Voice A]
Sounds like music to my ears. Being sent to a foreign land with air pollution was bad enough, now haunted with memories of this place...
scripts.translation:
[未知聲音 A]
這話我愛聽。被派到那個空氣汙染嚴重的異國他鄉已經夠糟了，現在還要被這個地方的回憶所困擾...

scripts.text:
[Unknown Voice A]
What do you think? Should we rotate now?
scripts.translation:
[未知聲音 A]
你覺得呢？我們現在該輪換了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Unknown Voice B]
Haven't given up, have ya. Do you really think he'll approve?
scripts.translation:
[未知聲音 B]
看來你還沒放棄啊。你真覺得他會批准嗎？

scripts.text:
[Unknown Voice A]
No need to be bitter. Hey! Were any of the kids that come and go here the ones that found the ^BD0408place^BD0408?
scripts.translation:
[未知聲音 A]
別這麼酸嘛。嘿！那些來來去去的小孩裡，有發現^BD0408那個地方^BD0408的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Unknown Voice B]
Since finding the hidden place was also a part of the test.
scripts.translation:
[未知聲音 B]
畢竟發現那個隱藏的地方也是考驗的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Unknown Voice A]
You are as stubborn as the first time I met you. It's just a wall in some place...
scripts.translation:
[未知聲音 A]
你和你第一次見面時一樣固執。那只是某個地方的一堵牆而已...

scripts.text:
[Unknown Voice B]
Shssh! I think someone is eavesdropping. Hurry! Go back to the mission area.
scripts.translation:
[未知聲音 B]
噓！好像有人在偷聽。快！回到任務區域去。

scripts.text: The conversation stopped abruptly. Hidden place? Wall? Part of a test? What is all this about?
scripts.translation: 對話突然停止了。隱藏的地方？牆？考驗的一部分？這到底是怎麼回事？

scripts.text: You should no longer use this secret passage.
scripts.translation: 你不應該再使用這條秘密通道了。

scripts.text: You found a location that resembles the hidden place.
scripts.translation: 你發現了一個與隱藏地點相似的地方。

scripts.text: This wall was here ever since. How come I didn't notice it before?
scripts.translation: 這堵牆一直都在這裡。為什麼我之前沒注意到？

scripts.text: Now that I know it's a secret passage, what do I do to get in?
scripts.translation: 既然知道這是條秘密通道，我該怎麼做才能進去？

scripts.text: Tear the drawing down.
scripts.translation: 撕下畫

scripts.text: Touch the drawing with your hand.
scripts.translation: 用手觸控畫

scripts.text: I can't rip it down because I don't own it.
scripts.translation: 我不能把它撕下來，因為它不是我的。

scripts.text: You touch the drawing with the tip of your hand and felt a sudden sensation of being pulled.
scripts.translation: 你用指尖輕輕觸碰了那幅畫，突然感到一股被拉扯的感覺。

scripts.text: Entrance to the ^25C18DNinja Guild^000000 hideout.
scripts.translation: ^25C18D忍者公會^000000據點的入口。

scripts.text: Enter.
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Do not enter.
scripts.translation: 不要進入

scripts.text: When touching the drawing, you get the feeling of being pulled...
scripts.translation: 觸控這幅畫時，你會感到一股被拉扯的感覺...

scripts.text: There is a wall with a great drawing on it.
scripts.translation: 牆上掛著一幅巨大的畫。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
You don't need to carry so many things.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
你不需要攜帶這麼多東西。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
You are not in the clan of the Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
你並不屬於忍者一族。

scripts.text: ^1A95E6An old man looking hale and hearty is sitting and gazing vacantly.^1A95E6
scripts.translation: ^1A95E6一位看起來精神矍鑠的老人正坐著，目光呆滯地望著前方。^1A95E6

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text: Talk to him.
scripts.translation: 和他談談。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me...
^1A95E6You tried to talk to the old man but there is no response. Just when you are about to turn away...^1A95E6
scripts.translation: ^1A95E6你試圖與老人交談，但他沒有回應。就在你準備轉身離開時...^1A95E6

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
At last, a customer! Hmm... and a live one, too!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
終於有顧客了！嗯...還是個活人！

scripts.text: Excuse me... where am I?
scripts.translation: 打擾一下...我在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
^1A95E6He keeps talking and doesn't stop to answer your question.^1A95E6
scripts.translation:
[老人]
^1A95E6他一直在說話，並沒有停下來回答你的問題。^1A95E6

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
There once was a quiet clan living in ancient Amatsu times that is never mentioned in history books or stories.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
在古老的櫻花城時代，曾有一個安靜的氏族，他們從未被記載在歷史書籍或故事中。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
They lived beneath shadows but always yearned for the bright sun, like a sunflower.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他們生活在陰影之下，卻總是渴望明亮的陽光，就像向日葵一樣。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
A clan that was loyal to their lord who they served as their bright sun.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
這是一個忠誠於其領主的氏族，他們將領主視為他們的太陽。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
...a very trustworthy clan...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
...一個非常值得信賴的氏族...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
....loyal to their core...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
....從心底裡忠誠...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
...a clan of integrity...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
...一個正直的氏族...

scripts.text: What happened to them?
scripts.translation: 他們後來怎麼樣了？

scripts.text: ^1A95E6The old man looks at you with a melancholy face.^1A95E6
scripts.translation: ^1A95E6老人用憂鬱的神情看著你。^1A95E6

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Why are you interested in a clan that was abandoned by their lord and disappeared from history itself?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
為什麼你要對一個被領主拋棄、甚至從歷史中消失的氏族感興趣呢？

scripts.text: I'm a Ninja.
scripts.translation: 我是忍者。

scripts.text: I'm bored.
scripts.translation: 我有點無聊。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Was nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
很高興認識你。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Ninja! There was a time when the clan was called ninjas, too.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
忍者！曾經，這個氏族也被稱為忍者。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
You'll have to lend me your ear for I have so much to tell you about the clan story.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
請耐心聽我說，關於這個氏族的故事，我有太多想告訴你的了。

scripts.text: ^1A95E6The Old Man starts the story with a very soothing tone as if he is telling his grandchild a story.^1A95E6
scripts.translation: ^1A95E6老人用非常柔和的語調開始講述，就像在給孫輩講故事一樣。^1A95E6

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
This goes way back to ancient times and nobody in Amatsu remembers about it.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
這要追溯到很久以前的古代，櫻花城已經沒有人記得這段歷史了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
The clan worked behind the scenes and basically lived their lives for their lord.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
這個氏族在幕後運作，基本上是為了領主而活。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
They were very loyal doing whatever deed their lord asked for.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他們非常忠誠，領主吩咐什麼，他們就做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Ninja, the clan was known as the dark clan but that doesn't mean they wanted to be hidden in the darkness.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
忍者，這個氏族被稱為黑暗氏族，但這並不意味著他們想要隱藏在黑暗中。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
They were loyal enough to be satisfied as the lord's servants but their loyalty became the problem.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他們足夠忠誠，滿足於做領主的僕人，但正是這種忠誠成了問題。

scripts.text: Problem?
scripts.translation: 問題？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
They are a secret organization that even the lord didn't know much about.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他們是一個秘密組織，連領主對他們知之甚少。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
The few that knew about the clan's existence, tried to investigate them but nobody was able to reveal their true identity.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
少數知道這個氏族存在的人試圖調查他們，但沒有人能揭示他們的真實身份。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
That is why this clan has grown from loyal servants to a group feared for its secrets.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
這就是為什麼這個氏族從忠誠的僕人，變成了一個因秘密而令人恐懼的團體。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
The lord shunned the clan and didn't call them for their service any more but they never betrayed him.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
領主疏遠了這個氏族，不再召喚他們服役，但他們從未背叛過他。

scripts.text: They were really loyal people.
scripts.translation: 他們真是忠誠的人。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Yes, they were. Very loyal.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
是的，他們很忠誠。非常忠誠。

scripts.text: ^1A95E6The old man looks even more forlorn.^1A95E6
scripts.translation: ^1A95E6老人的神情顯得更加落寞。^1A95E6

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
The clan has been living in hiding for so long since the old days. The current lord didn't even know of their existence.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
自遠古以來，這個氏族一直生活在隱匿之中。現任領主甚至不知道他們的存在。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I'm Leader Gion, the last of the dark ninja clan.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我是首領 吉翁，黑暗忍者氏族最後的成員。

scripts.text: I think your time has ended.
scripts.translation: 我想你的時代已經結束了。

scripts.text: I need your teaching.
scripts.translation: 我想拜師學藝。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Are you an assassin to end this old man's life?
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
你是來取我這條老命的刺客嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
So that is why you've shown interest in my clan. I won't give up easily.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
原來你對我這個氏族這麼感興趣。我不會輕易放棄的。

scripts.text:
Pow!!
^1A95E6You lose conscience with the great impact.^000000
scripts.translation:
砰！！
^1A95E6你被巨大的衝擊力震得失去了意識。^000000

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Teaching...
Been a long time since I last heard that word.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
拜師...
好久沒聽到這個詞了。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I guess this little visit was not by coincidence but a start of a connection.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
看來這次偶遇並非巧合，而是某種緣分的開始。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Sorry I am not a teacher. But!
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
抱歉，我不是老師。但是！

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I can help you on the path you've chosen, the ^33CC71{0}^000000 path.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
我可以指引你走上你所選擇的^33CC71{0}^000000之路。

scripts.text: ^1A95E6You hear Leader Gion's voice faintly as you slip away.^1A95E6
scripts.translation: ^1A95E6你在恍惚中聽到首領 吉翁的聲音漸漸遠去。^1A95E6

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
If you are prepared to follow me, Leader Gion, on the {0} path, we will meet again.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
如果你準備好跟隨我，首領 吉翁，踏上{0}之路，我們還會再見的。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I thought you were afraid of the ^33CC71path of the {0}^33CC71 and wouldn't come back.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
我以為你害怕^33CC71{0}之路^33CC71，不會回來了。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
But from the look of your eyes, I guess I misjudged you.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
但從你的眼神來看，看來是我看錯你了。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You will have to train your mind and body to walk steadily in the unknown world and never fall into temptation to stay on the path.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
你必須磨練身心，才能在未知的世界中穩步前行，且不被誘惑而偏離正道。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Our ancestors had 4 tests to train our people.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
我們的祖先有四項試煉來訓練族人。

scripts.text: 4 tests?
scripts.translation: 四項試煉？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Yes, there are 4 tests.
My ancestors trained my people with 4 tests that involve ^087FF8knowledge^000000, ^087FF8survival^000000, ^087FF8weapons^000000, and ^087FF8battle^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
是的，共有四項試煉。
我的祖先通過涉及^087FF8知識^000000、^087FF8生存^000000、^087FF8武器^000000和^087FF8戰鬥^000000的四項試煉來訓練族人。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I know you are curious what these tests are. Let me explain one by one.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
我知道你很好奇這些試煉是什麼。讓我逐一解釋。

scripts.text: Test of Knowledge
scripts.translation: 知識試煉

scripts.text: Test of Survival
scripts.translation: 生存試煉

scripts.text: Test of Weaponry
scripts.translation: 武器試煉

scripts.text: Test of Battle
scripts.translation: 戰鬥試煉

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
We need to be knowledgeable in order to assist the lord. This test is for this purpose.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
我們需要具備知識來輔佐領主。這項試煉正是為此而設。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You can pass the test if you successfully solve more than 9 out of 10 questions.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
如果你能答對10道題中的9道以上，就能通過試煉。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
The test will be easy to pass if you've been steady in your studies. Now what other test are you curious about?
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
如果你平時學習刻苦，這項試煉會很容易通過。那麼，你還想了解哪項試煉？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Missions aren't always easy and safe. That is why survival instincts are vital to us.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
任務並不總是輕鬆且安全的。因此，生存本能對我們至關重要。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
My ancestors call this test the dice test. It is a test to advance forward depending on the dice results.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
我的祖先稱這項試煉為“骰子試煉”。它需要根據骰子的點數來決定前進的方向。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Think of it as the simple dice games people play.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
你可以把它想像成人們常玩的簡單骰子游戲。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
But never let your guard down during the test because it isn't called the survival test for nothing.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
但在試煉中切勿掉以輕心，畢竟它被稱為“生存試煉”絕非沒有道理。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
There will be blocks that help you while there are blocks that will interrupt you.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
會有幫助你前進的方塊，也會有阻礙你的方塊。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
If you deal with various situations wisely, you will be able to pass the test. Now what other test are you curious about?
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
如果你能明智地應對各種狀況，就能通過試煉。那麼，你還想了解哪項試煉？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
My clan was famous for using unique weapons that we created.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
我的氏族以使用我們自制的獨特武器而聞名。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You would be considered blessed if you created your own unique weapon.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
如果你能打造出屬於自己的獨特武器，那將是一種榮幸。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Creating a weapon for yourself and refining it is the purpose of this test.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
為自己打造武器並加以精煉，正是這項試煉的目的。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I hope you will be blessed and find the best weapon for yourself. Now what other test are you curious about?
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
希望你能獲得眷顧，找到最適合自己的武器。那麼，你還想了解哪項試煉？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Missions are not always done alone. You will often work in teams of 2 or 3 for a common goal.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
任務並非總是獨自完成的。為了共同的目標，你經常需要與2到3人組隊行動。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
The battle test is only for those that pass that knowledge, survival and weapon tests. So! It is the very last test.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
戰鬥試煉僅面向通過了知識、生存和武器試煉的人。所以！這是最後一項試煉。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Unlike the other three tests that are done alone, you will have to compete with others in this final test.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
與其他三項獨自進行的試煉不同，在這最後一項試煉中，你必須與他人競爭。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
There is only one target!!
And only the first to get to the target passes the test.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
只有一個目標！！
只有第一個到達目標的人才能通過試煉。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You'll be lucky if you have no competitors during your test.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
如果你在試煉中沒有競爭對手，那真是走運了。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
A challenge is better than explaining it a hundred times. It's the actual experience that makes you better.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
親身體驗比解釋一百遍都更有意義。正是實際經歷讓你變得更強。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Seeing is believing, so go on and take the challenge.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
眼見為實，那就去接受挑戰吧。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Let's start right away after you are done with preparations.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
等你準備就緒，我們就立刻開始。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
It's been a while.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
好久不見了。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Since I felt happy like this. I feel young and energetic seeing young people like you challenge themselves with a new path.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
因為感到如此快樂，看著像你們這樣的年輕人挑戰自己、探索新道路，我覺得自己年輕又充滿活力。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
We're done with explaining about the tests, now should I tell you my clan story?
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
關於試煉的說明已經結束了，現在我要講講我氏族的故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
My clan started from two warriors.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
我的氏族起源於兩名戰士。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Kagerou, a warrior like the dancing flames of the sun.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
影狼，如太陽的舞焰般的戰士。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Oboro, a warrior like the misty moonlight.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
朧，如朦朧月光般的戰士。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
The Sun and the Moon.
The sunlight that lights up the world and the moonlight that lights up the night. Both were very similar but different warriors.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
太陽與月亮。
照亮世界的陽光與照亮夜晚的月光。兩者非常相似，卻是不同的戰士。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
There was a time there was an enmity between both warriors.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
曾有一段時間，這兩位戰士之間產生了敵意。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
But it didn't take long for them to become one as a clan.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
但沒過多久，他們就合二為一，成為了一個氏族。

scripts.text: How did it go afterwards?
scripts.translation: 後來怎麼樣了？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Ha ha ha. It is never fun to listen to the whole story all at once, no? Come back after passing a test and I'll continue my story.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
哈哈哈哈哈。一口氣聽完整個故事並不有趣，對吧？通過試煉後再回來，我會繼續講我的故事。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Which test will you select as your first test?
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
你選擇哪項試煉作為你的第一項試煉？

scripts.text: Test of Knowledge
scripts.translation: 知識試煉

scripts.text: Test of Survival
scripts.translation: 生存試煉

scripts.text: Test of Weaponry
scripts.translation: 武器試煉

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You've passed the Test of Knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
你通過了知識試煉。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You've passed the Test of Survival.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
你通過了生存試煉。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You've passed the Test of Weaponry.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
你通過了武器試煉。

scripts.text: [Leader Gion]
scripts.translation: [首領 吉翁]

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
My friend doesn't approve of others that easily but I guess he liked you.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
我的朋友不輕易認可他人，但我想他喜歡你。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Looks like you went through hell with this test.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
看來你在這項試煉中經歷了一番地獄般的考驗。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I wonder if Joe is satisfied with your performance.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
不知道喬對你的表現是否滿意。

scripts.text: Please continue with the clan story.
scripts.translation: 請繼續講述氏族的故事。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Looks like you are pretty eager to hear more. Where did I leave off... Ah! I remember.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
看來你很急切地想聽後續。我講到哪兒了...啊！我想起來了。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Kagerou, a warrior like the dancing flames of the sun.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
影狼，如太陽的舞焰般的戰士。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Oboro, a warrior like the misty moonlight.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
朧，如朦朧月光般的戰士。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Both warriors weren't close at first, because personality and everything else was completely opposite of each other.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
起初這兩位戰士並不親近，因為他們的性格和各方面都截然相反。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
The first place they met was the battlefield. And you know how enemies greet each other on a battlefield.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
他們第一次相遇是在戰場上。你知道敵人在戰場上是如何互相問候的。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
They ended up injuring each other badly.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
結果他們互相受了重傷。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
But what can you do? War is a war.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
但又能怎麼辦呢？戰爭就是戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
The friend you've laughed with yesterday is a foe that you have to fight with in a war today.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
昨天還能一起談笑的朋友，今天可能就是戰爭中必須對抗的敵人。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
So nobody can get along with anyone during a war.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
所以在戰爭中，沒有人能與他人和睦相處。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I'll continue the story after you pass another test.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
等你通過另一項試煉後，我再繼續講故事。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Which test will you choose for the second test?
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
第二項試煉，你想選擇哪一項？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You've passed the ^339CCCTests of Knowledge and Survival^000000!
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
你通過了^339CCC知識與生存試煉^000000！

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You've passed the ^339CCCTests of Knowledge and Weaponry^000000!
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
你通過了^339CCC知識與武器試煉^000000！

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You've passed the ^339CCCTests of Survival and Weaponry^000000!
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
你通過了^339CCC生存與武器試煉^000000！

scripts.text: [Leader Gion]
scripts.translation: [首領 吉翁]

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You are already done with two tests. Hope you've learned a lot from them.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
你已經完成了兩項試煉。希望你在其中有所收穫。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Shall we continue with the story?
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
我們要繼續講故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Kagerou, a warrior like the dancing flames of the sun.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
影狼，如太陽的舞焰般的戰士。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Oboro, a warrior like the misty moonlight.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
朧，如朦朧月光般的戰士。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I think I left off when the two warriors met at the battlefield as enemies.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
我想我上次講到兩位戰士作為敵人在戰場上相遇的時候。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
The long war ended eventually but the wounds and pain of those that survived had just started.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
漫長的戰爭終於結束了，但倖存者的傷痛和痛苦才剛剛開始。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
So these two warriors started to embrace and heal the war wounds together and became one.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
於是這兩位戰士開始相互扶持，共同治癒戰爭的創傷，併合二為一。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
There is a backstory of a man appearing in front of them and winning the loyalty from both warriors.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
還有一個背景故事，關於一名男子出現在他們面前，並贏得了兩位戰士的忠誠。

scripts.text: Who is this man?
scripts.translation: 這個人是誰？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
There isn't much known about this man. Only a short mentioning of the two warriors pledging their allegiance.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
關於這個人，已知的資訊不多。只有關於兩位戰士宣誓效忠的簡短記載。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Maybe current generations like me are the ancestors of the current Amatsu lord? But this is only an assumption.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
也許像我這樣的當代人，是現任櫻花城領主的祖先？但這只是推測。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I'm almost at the end of my clan story. Come back after you've passed the third test and I will tell you the rest.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
我的氏族故事快講完了。等你通過第三項考驗後再來，我會告訴你剩下的部分。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You've gone through three tests leaving only one to pass.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
你已經通過了三項考驗，只剩最後一項了。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
As I've told you before, the last test is different because you have to compete against others.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
正如我之前所說，最後一項考驗不同，因為你需要與其他人競爭。

scripts.text: Will you continue the story?
scripts.translation: 要繼續故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Ha ha ha. I will finish the story.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
哈哈。我會講完故事的。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Kagerou, a warrior like the dancing flames of the sun.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
影狼，如太陽的舞焰般的戰士。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Oboro, a warrior like the misty moonlight.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
朧，如朦朧月光般的戰士。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
It is told that the man that earned the loyalty of the two warriors was a humorous person.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
據說贏得兩位戰士忠誠的那個人，是個幽默的人。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
He like the jokes and conversations better than quarrels and he liked women over men.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
比起爭吵，他更喜歡玩笑和交談；比起男人，他更喜歡女人。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Hmm... I don't know why this part of the story was kept alive all these years but this man wanted to bring these two warriors together.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
嗯...我不知道為什麼這部分故事流傳了這麼多年，但這個人想把這兩位戰士撮合在一起。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Both warriors did travel together after the war but kept an awkward distance from each other.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
戰後，兩位戰士確實一起旅行，但彼此保持著尷尬的距離。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
They must have had their reasons but their lord would send them out to a difficult mission together, put them in a secret room together and all sorts of situations together.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
他們肯定有自己的理由，但他們的領主會派他們一起執行艱難的任務，把他們關在密室裡，或者安排各種讓他們在一起的情況。

scripts.text: Sounds like an odd person.
scripts.translation: 聽起來像個怪人。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Yes, he was. And his efforts didn't go in vain since the two warriors eventually got acquainted and married.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
是的，他就是那樣。他的努力沒有白費，兩位戰士最終相識並結為夫妻。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
This is how the clan started.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
氏族就是這樣開始的。

scripts.text: What happened after?
scripts.translation: 後來發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Sadly, the next part of story was purposely discontinued.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
遺憾的是，故事的下一部分被故意中斷了。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I think it's because someone wanted us to let go of the past and move forward.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
我想這是因為有人希望我們放下過去，向前看。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
That's that. Now shouldn't you be preparing for the last test?
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
就是這樣。現在你不該去準備最後一項考驗嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
But you must be tired from all the tests so far. Take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
不過，經歷了這麼多考驗，你一定累壞了吧。好好休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Weren't you taking the Test of {0} just now?
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
你剛才不是正在參加{0}的考驗嗎？

scripts.text: I want to go back to test site.
scripts.translation: 我想回到考驗地點。

scripts.text: Ah... no.
scripts.translation: 啊...不了。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
The Test of {0} site is over here.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
{0}的考驗地點在這邊。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
The village is over here.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
村莊在那邊。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You've come back already? You could have rested more. Is there a reason to hurry?
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
這麼快就回來了？你本可以多休息一會兒的。有什麼急事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Because of ^B24E59{0}^000000?

[Leader Gion]
I have to admit, I don't understand you now.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
我得承認，我現在有點看不懂你了。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
But since you've gone through much, I'm sure you will do good with the final test.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
不過既然你已經經歷了這麼多，我相信你一定能順利通過最後的考驗。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Now! No more small talk. I'll let you know what the target is for the Test of Battle.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
好了！不再閒聊了。我來告訴你戰鬥考驗的目標是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
The target is a monster called the ^FF0000Clan Secret^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
目標是名為^FF0000氏族秘密^000000的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You will have to be careful because there are many similiar shaped and named monsters in test site.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
你要小心，因為考驗地點有很多外形和名字都很相似的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
And if you are lucky, there will be others targeting the monster.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
而且如果你運氣好，還會有其他人也在攻擊這隻魔物。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
May the blessings of '{0}' be with you.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
願'{0}'的賜福與你同在。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Then let's go to the battle test field.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
那麼，讓我們去戰鬥考驗場吧。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I see you are in the middle of the ^339CCCTest of Battle^000000. Will you go back to the test site?
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
看來你正在參加^339CCC戰鬥考驗^000000。要回到考驗地點嗎？

scripts.text: Go back to the test site.
scripts.translation: 回到考驗地點

scripts.text: Visit the village.
scripts.translation: 去村莊

[Leader Gion]
The village is over here.

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You should not be here. Leave!
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
你不該出現在這裡。離開！

哈哈哈哈哈。到了那裡你就知道了。知識考驗在那邊進行。

scripts.text: < Used {0} LP >
scripts.translation: < 消耗了 {0} LP >

scripts.text: Press Close to move to block 39.
scripts.translation: 點選關閉以移動到39號格子。

scripts.text: Please roll the dice.
scripts.translation: 請擲骰子。

scripts.text: There are tiny letters on the sign.
scripts.translation: 標示上有細小的文字。

scripts.text: There are only 4 blocks left till the last block.
scripts.translation: 距離最後一個格子只剩下4個格子了。

scripts.text:
Rule 1 (Normal Dice Roll)
You get to pass if you get 4 or above but nobody knows what will come from a dice roll.
scripts.translation:
規則1（普通擲骰）
擲出4或以上即可通過，但沒人知道骰子會擲出什麼。

scripts.text:
Rule 2
If you get 1, 2, or 3 you move right to the arrival point; if you get 4, 5, or 6 you get to choose to move to block 29.
scripts.translation:
規則2
擲出1、2或3，直接移動到終點；擲出4、5或6，可以選擇移動到29號格子。

scripts.text: Try it the other way.
scripts.translation: 試試另一種方式

scripts.text: Go by the rules.
scripts.translation: 按規則來

scripts.text: Press Close to move to the end.
scripts.translation: 點選關閉以移動到終點。

scripts.text: Press Close to move to block 29.
scripts.translation: 點選關閉以移動到29號格子。

scripts.text: Press Close to move to forward {0} blocks.
scripts.translation: 點選關閉以向前移動{0}格。

scripts.text: There are tiny letters on the sign.
scripts.translation: 標示上有細小的文字。

scripts.text: There are only 3 blocks left to the finish line but you can't you go so easily.
scripts.translation: 距離終點只剩3格了，但你不能這麼輕易地過去。

scripts.text: If you get 1, 3, or 5, move to the arrival point; if you get 2, 4, or 6, go back to the starting point.
scripts.translation: 如果擲出1、3或5，移動到終點；如果擲出2、4或6，回到起點。

scripts.text: Press Close to move to the last block.
scripts.translation: 點選關閉以移動到最後一格。

scripts.text: Press Close to move to the starting point.
scripts.translation: 點選關閉以移動到起點。

scripts.text: There are tiny letters on the sign.
scripts.translation: 標示上有細小的文字。

scripts.text: Leave 1 LP and invest the remaining LP to install the trap to bring down other players!
scripts.translation: 保留1點LP，將剩餘的LP用於安裝陷阱，以擊倒其他玩家！

scripts.text: There is currently no trap installed. Do you want to install a trap?
scripts.translation: 當前未安裝任何陷阱。是否要安裝陷阱？

scripts.text: Install a trap.
scripts.translation: 安裝陷阱

scripts.text: Do not install.
scripts.translation: 不安裝

scripts.text: < Used {0} LP >
scripts.translation: < 消耗了 {0} LP >

scripts.text: The trap is installed. Please roll the dice.
scripts.translation: 陷阱已安裝。請擲骰子。

scripts.text: Did not set a trap. Please roll the dice.
scripts.translation: 未設定陷阱。請擲骰子。

scripts.text: You are caught in the trap installed. Press Close to go back to block 0.
scripts.translation: 你觸發了已安裝的陷阱。點選關閉以回到0號格子。

scripts.text: Press Close to move forward {0} blocks.
scripts.translation: 點選關閉以向前移動{0}格。

scripts.text: There are tiny letters on the sign.
scripts.translation: 標示上有細小的文字。

scripts.text: Now there is only 1 block left till the end. Congratulations on all you've been through to get here.
scripts.translation: 現在距離終點只剩1格了。恭喜你能走到這裡。

scripts.text: But you cannot go so easily. If you get a 3, you will go back to block 3.
scripts.translation: 但你不能這麼輕易地過去。如果擲出3，你將回到3號格子。

scripts.text: Press Close to move to the 3rd block.
scripts.translation: 點選關閉以移動到3號格子。

scripts.text: Press Close to move to the arrival point.
scripts.translation: 點選關閉以移動到終點。

scripts.text: You should not be here.
scripts.translation: 你不應該在這裡。

scripts.text: You must be here by mistake.
scripts.translation: 你一定是走錯地方了。

scripts.text: There are tiny letters on the sign.
scripts.translation: 標示上有細小的文字。

scripts.text:
To those you are preparing for a new turn...
Well begun is half done. However always remember it is not the end.
scripts.translation:
給那些正準備開始新一輪的人...
好的開始是成功的一半。但請記住，這還不是結束。

scripts.text:
Let's read all the writing on the sign.
You feel like you are moved to another place.
scripts.translation:
讓我們讀一讀標示上的所有文字。
你感覺自己彷彿被傳送到了另一個地方。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Go reduce your weight! This test will be too difficult otherwise...
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
去減減肥！不然這測試會很難通過...

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Sorry, your clan is not the same as ours, is there something wrong?
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
抱歉，你的氏族不是我們的，是不是有什麼誤會？

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
You are not supposed to be here...
It's my duty to get rid of you,
so I'll send you back now!
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
你不應該出現在這裡...
清除你是我的職責，
所以我現在就把你送回去！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
It's been a while!
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
好久不見！

scripts.text: Long time indeed, Joe.
scripts.translation: 確實很久了，喬。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
You aren't surprised I'm here. Did you meet ^0237FDKuuga Gai^000000 before coming here?
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
你對我出現在這裡並不感到驚訝。來之前你見過^0237FD空牙·蓋^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Don't like it that I'm not the first one you visited but that is not important.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
我不喜歡你沒先拜訪我，但這並不重要。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Alright, {0}!
Welcome to the workshop where weapons are created for the clan.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
好了，{0}！
歡迎來到為氏族打造武器的工坊。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Our clan has been creating and using unique weapons to serve our secret missions since ancient times.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
自古以來，我們的氏族就一直在製造和使用獨特的武器，以執行秘密任務。

scripts.text: Really? At Einbroch?
scripts.translation: 真的嗎？在艾音布羅克？

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Hmm? You are not as slow as I thought you were!
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
嗯？你並不像我想像中那麼遲鈍！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Yes. Einbroch is known as an industrial city, the city of great blacksmiths create new technology.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
是的。艾音布羅克以工業城市聞名，偉大的鐵匠們在這裡創造新技術。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
My mission is to analyze their technology and report back to the clan.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
我的任務是解析他們的技術，並向氏族彙報。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
I spoke more than I intended to.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
我說的比預想的多了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Did you bring enough ^6848B7Iron Ore, Iron, Steel, Phracon, Emveretaron, Rough Oridecon, and Rough Elunium^000000?
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
你帶了足夠的^6848B7鐵礦石、鐵、鋼、強化武器金屬-級數一、Emveretaron、神之金屬原石和鋁原石^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Let's now create a new prototype weapon.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
現在讓我們製造一把新的原型武器。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Feel free to use tools from here, and...
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
請隨意使用這裡的工具，還有...

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
...there...

[Red Leopard Joe]
...and everywhere else. Now let's begin!!
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
...以及其他地方。現在讓我們開始吧！！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Hmm... Interesting... Is it a dagger in a shape of a Kunai?
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
嗯...有意思...這是一把呈苦無形狀的短劍嗎？

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Very creative. I do see room for improvement but the weapon itself may come out useful after smoothing it out a bit.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
非常有創意。雖然還有改進的空間，但稍微打磨一下後，這把武器可能會很有用。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Hmm... Is this an Ordinary Huuma?
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
嗯...這是一把普通的武器嗎？

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Ahh, Its not an Ordinary Huuma.
Very creative. I do see room for improvement but the weapon itself may come out useful after smoothing it out a bit.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
啊，這不是普通的武器。
非常有創意。雖然還有改進的空間，但稍微打磨一下後，這把武器可能會很有用。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Ahh, how is it possible? You don't have weapons? Maybe you equipped it?
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
啊，這怎麼可能？你沒有武器嗎？也許你把它裝備上了？

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Good. I think you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
很好。我覺得你準備好了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Now it's time to upgrade?
There are refinement tools on both sides of me. Use those to refine a weapon and come back.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
現在是時候進行強化了。
我兩邊都有強化工具。用它們強化武器，然後回來。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
I created the refinement tools myself with great effort so you won't have any trouble using them.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
這些強化工具是我費盡心思製作的，所以你使用時不會有任何困難。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Ah... But just in case,
^FF0000be careful not to cause trouble by showing these to blacksmiths outside of here.^000000
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
啊...不過以防萬一，
^FF0000小心不要把這些東西拿給這裡的鐵匠看，以免惹上麻煩。^000000

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Did you get a successful result?
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
你得到滿意的結果了嗎？

scripts.text: Not yet.
scripts.translation: 還沒有準備好。

scripts.text: Here it is.
scripts.translation: 在這裡。

scripts.text: Actually...
scripts.translation: 實際上...

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
It isn't easy to get a satisfactory result at first.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
一開始很難得到滿意的結果。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
You've lost the weapon even with my warning.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
即使我警告過你，你還是失去了武器。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Nothing else we can do. Wait!
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
我們別無他法。等等！

scripts.text: Red Leopard Joe mumbles something and suddenly all weapons are unequipped.
scripts.translation: 紅豹 喬嘟囔了幾句，突然所有武器都被卸下了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
What is this? You still have the prototype. Stop playing around.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
這是什麼？你還有原型。別胡鬧了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Oh! You really lost it.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
哦！你真的弄丟了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Well! Lets try to make it again!
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
好吧！讓我們再試一次！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Looks like you've got some results.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
看起來你得到了一些結果。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Ahh! You have not equipped any weapons!
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
啊！你沒有裝備任何武器！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Is that weapon yours? Let me have a look.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
那把武器是你的嗎？讓我看看。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Are you certain it's that weapon?
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
你確定是那把武器嗎？

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
You plan to trick me with that? Again!!
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
你打算用這種把戲騙我？又是這樣！！

scripts.text: Joe took a thorough look at the seal.
scripts.translation: 喬仔細檢查了海豹寶寶。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Are you that low?
I must have misjudged you. You might have been satisfied yourself but I'm not. Do it again!!
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
你的水平就這麼低嗎？
看來是我看錯你了。你自己可能覺得滿意了，但我並不滿意。再做一次！！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Hmm... Is this your limit?
You've just made it that close to passing. I will ask one more time, are you satisfied?
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
嗯...這就是你的極限了嗎？
你離通過只差一步之遙。我再問一次，你滿意嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
You're still here. Why?
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
你還在這裡。為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Your competence is enough.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
你的能力足夠了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Ah, as I expected.
I still believe that you will not stop here.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
啊，果然如此。
我依然相信你不會止步於此。

scripts.text: I want to stop.
scripts.translation: 我想停止。

scripts.text: I want to continue.
scripts.translation: 我想繼續。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
I will look forward for your result.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
我會期待你的成果。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Your competence is enough.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
你的能力足夠了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Better than expected.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
比預期的要好。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
For beginners, quite good. This test may not be significant to you, but your competence is enough.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
對於初學者來說，相當不錯。這次測試對你來說可能不算什麼，但你的能力足夠了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
I can feel it.
I will take this weapon to give it some finishing touches.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
我能感覺到。
我會把這件武器拿去進行最後的修飾。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
'{0}'
Passed the weapon test!!
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
'{0}'
通過了武器測試！！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Oh, I almost forgot.
Go report the test results to Gion!
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
哦，我差點忘了。
去把測試結果彙報給吉恩！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
You should not have come here...
It's my duty to get rid of you.
This will push you back!
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
你不該來這裡...
除掉你是我的職責。
這一擊會把你打回去！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Are you done making the prototype of the new weapons?
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
新武器的原型製作好了嗎？

scripts.text: Crafting tools?
scripts.translation: 製作工具？

scripts.text: I don't have enough materials.
scripts.translation: 材料不足。

scripts.text: How do you expect me to make a weapon?{0}
scripts.translation: 你指望我怎麼製作武器？{0}

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Feel free to use tools from here, and...
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
請隨意使用這裡的工具，還有...

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
...there...

[Red Leopard Joe]
...and everywhere else.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
...以及其它地方。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
You haven't brought enough materials?
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
你帶的材料不夠嗎？

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Then we'll have to pay a visit to the village. Try the ^FF0000drawer^000000 over there. It'll take you to the village.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
那我們得去一趟村莊。試試那邊的^FF0000抽屜^000000，它會帶你去村莊。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Hmm... Guess I expected too much? Let me explain.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
嗯...看來是我期望太高了？讓我解釋一下。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
You first have to melt the ore to use for the weapon. And the best way to get high purity metal is to melt materials that are of the same kind.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
首先，你必須熔煉礦石才能用於製作武器。而獲得高純度金屬的最佳方法，是熔煉同種類的材質。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
For example, Iron Ore, Iron, and Steel are of similar property so you can get a high purity metal out of them.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
例如，鐵礦石、鐵和鋼的性質相似，因此可以從中獲得高純度金屬。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Once you've melted a high purity metal, pour it in a mold to get the shape of the weapon and then make it firm through grinding and tempering.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
一旦熔煉出高純度金屬，將其倒入模具中形成武器的形狀，然後通過研磨和淬火使其定型。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
By the way, you will get the best results by thoroughly rotating, grinding and tempering.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
順便說一句，充分進行旋轉、研磨和淬火，你會得到最好的效果。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
I think this is enough to get you started, don't you think? Now go and work on that prototype!!
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
我覺得這些足以讓你入門了，你覺得呢？現在去製作那個原型吧！！

scripts.text: There is some kind of device on the drawer.
scripts.translation: 抽屜上有一種裝置。

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text: Try to operate it.
scripts.translation: 嘗試操作它。

scripts.text: Clank clunk clink
scripts.translation: 咔噠 咔噠 叮噹

scripts.text: Too heavy! Please reduce your weight.
scripts.translation: 太重了！請減輕你的重量。

scripts.text:
A crafting tool.
Don't really need it now.
scripts.translation:
製作工具。
現在似乎用不上。

scripts.text: Tool to create weapons.
scripts.translation: 用於製作武器的工具。

scripts.text: First need to melt metals like iron and iron ore to use to create a weapon.
scripts.translation: 首先需要熔煉鐵、鐵礦石等金屬，用於製作武器。

scripts.text: Melt Iron Ore.
scripts.translation: 熔煉鐵礦石。

scripts.text: Melt Iron.
scripts.translation: 熔煉鐵。

scripts.text: Melt Steel.
scripts.translation: 熔煉鋼。

scripts.text: Melt Phracon.
scripts.translation: 熔煉強化武器金屬-級數一。

scripts.text: Melt Emveretarcon.
scripts.translation: 熔煉強化武器金屬-級數二

scripts.text: Melt Rough Oridecon.
scripts.translation: 熔煉神之金屬原石

scripts.text: Melt Rough Elunium.
scripts.translation: 熔煉鋁原石

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text: Melted {0} in high temperature.
scripts.translation: 在高溫下熔煉了{0}。

scripts.text: Don't have {0}.
Which metal will be melted next?
scripts.translation: 接下來要熔煉哪種金屬？

scripts.text: Now the metal is melted to use for creating weapons.
scripts.translation: 現在金屬已經熔化，可以用來製作武器了。

scripts.text: Next is to make the melted metal firm by pouring it into a mold. Which mold shape will you use?
scripts.translation: 接下來是將熔化的金屬倒入模具中使其定型。您打算使用哪種形狀的模具？

scripts.text: Dagger Mold
scripts.translation: 短劍模具

scripts.text: Shuriken Mold
scripts.translation: 飛鏢模具

scripts.text: Poured the melted metal into the dagger mold.
scripts.translation: 將熔化的金屬倒入了短劍模具中。

scripts.text: Poured the melted metal into the shuriken mold.
scripts.translation: 將熔化的金屬倒入了飛鏢模具中。

scripts.text: Looks like the metal is taking shape. Now what next?
scripts.translation: 看起來金屬正在成型。接下來該做什麼？

scripts.text: Now what next?
scripts.translation: 接下來該做什麼？

scripts.text: Start to sharpen the tool using a whetstone for finishing touches.
scripts.translation: 開始使用磨刀石進行最後的打磨。

scripts.text: The weapon was created successfully.
scripts.translation: 武器製作成功。

scripts.text: Let's take it to Red Leopard Joe.
scripts.translation: 讓我們把它帶給紅豹 喬。

scripts.text: The weapon was destroyed while doing the finishing touches to it.
scripts.translation: 在進行最後的打磨時，武器被損壞了。

scripts.text: There must have been something missed while creating the weapon. Very sad this happened but you'll have to start all over again.
scripts.translation: 製作武器時一定有什麼地方疏忽了。雖然很遺憾，但您不得不重新開始。

scripts.text: But you do not have any more metal to melt. Let's try again after getting more metal.
scripts.translation: 但是您沒有更多可以熔煉的金屬了。等獲取更多金屬後再試試吧。

scripts.text: Grind the weapon
scripts.translation: 打磨武器

scripts.text: Temper the weapon{0}
scripts.translation: 淬火武器{0}

scripts.text: Ground the weapon.
scripts.translation: 已打磨武器。

scripts.text: Tempered the weapon.
scripts.translation: 已淬火武器。

scripts.text: This tool helps you refine your weapons automatically. However, you won't need this just now.
scripts.translation: 這個工具可以自動幫您精煉武器。不過，您現在還用不上它。

scripts.text:
You turn on the refinement tool.
The equipment starts up with a pleasant vibration.
scripts.translation:
您啟動了精煉工具。
裝置伴隨著令人愉悅的震動開始運轉。

scripts.text: Looks like you can use the tool right away for refinement because it holds a good deal of Elunium and Oridecon within it.
scripts.translation: 看起來您可以立即使用這個工具進行精煉，因為它內部含有大量的鋁和神之金屬。

scripts.text: Start refining.
scripts.translation: 開始精煉

scripts.text: Do not start refining.
scripts.translation: 不開始精煉

scripts.text: You turned off the tool.
scripts.translation: 您關閉了工具。

scripts.text:
Bzzzt
A warning beep comes from the tool.
scripts.translation:
嗶——
工具發出了警告聲。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
This equipment does not work without an equipped item to refine.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
如果沒有裝備待精煉的物品，這臺裝置無法工作。

scripts.text: Analyzing the weapon.
scripts.translation: 正在分析武器。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Wait... this weapon is not a customized one.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
等等...這把武器不是定製武器。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Why don't you refine this with those hot-headed blacksmiths out there?
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
您為什麼不去找外面那些脾氣火爆的鐵匠精煉呢？

scripts.text:
Bzzzt
A warning beep comes from the tool.
scripts.translation:
嗶——
工具發出了警告聲。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
That weapon cannot be refined. Where did you get it?
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
這把武器無法精煉。您是從哪裡弄來的？

scripts.text:
Bzzzt
A warning beep comes from the tool.
scripts.translation:
嗶——
工具發出了警告聲。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
This equipment is perfectly refined. Keep it for yourself!
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
這件裝備已經完美精煉了。請留作自用吧！

scripts.text: This is very well refined equipment. Do you want to continue? Refine skill decreases by 1 if refinement fails.
scripts.translation: 這是一件精煉度很高的裝備。您確定要繼續嗎？如果精煉失敗，精煉技能將降低1點。

scripts.text: Continue.
scripts.translation: 繼續

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text: You turned off the tool.
scripts.translation: 您關閉了工具。

scripts.text: Starting to refine.
scripts.translation: 開始精煉。

scripts.text:
Succeeded in refining.
Turned off the refining tool.
scripts.translation:
精煉成功。
已關閉精煉工具。

scripts.text:
Failed in refining.
Your weapon refinement skill dropped by 1.
Turned off the refining tool.
scripts.translation:
精煉失敗。
您的武器精煉技能下降了1點。
已關閉精煉工具。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You don't need so many things now!
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
你現在不需要這麼多東西了！

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Looks like you haven't taken care of the target yet.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
看來你還沒有處理掉目標。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I'll tell you once more. The target is the ^FF0000Clan Secret^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
我再告訴你一次。目標是^FF0000氏族秘寶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Of course the path will be difficult, so continue searching!
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
當然，路途會很艱難，所以請繼續尋找！

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Looks like you've taken care of the target. Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
看來你已經處理掉目標了。嗯。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
But please get down from your frog. Otherwise I can't continue!
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
請從青蛙上下來。否則我無法繼續！

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
How did you get weaker? Come back once you've regained your previous levels.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
你怎麼變弱了？等你恢復到之前的等級後再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Please come back after using all your Skill Points.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
請在使用完所有技能點後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
The Test of Battle will be put off for a while. Don't worry because this does not have affect to other tests.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
戰鬥測試將暫時推遲。不用擔心，這不會影響其他測試。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
My friend {0} made it to {1} Path. Congratulations!!
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
我的朋友{0}通過了{1}之路。恭喜！！

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
It is pleasant to meet a youth that is walking through a new path.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
很高興見到一位正在探索新道路的年輕人。

scripts.text:
[Someone's Voice]
Wait for a while, Gion.
scripts.translation:
[某人的聲音]
吉翁，等一下。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I'm sorry I almost forgot about you two. Do you have anything to share with {0}?
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
抱歉，我差點忘了你們兩個。你們有什麼想對{0}說的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Hmm... Embarrassing... to speak so suddenly...
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
嗯...突然說這些...有點尷尬...

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
{0}, you are now a proud member of our clan. Always hold your head high and...
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
{0}，你現在是我們氏族引以為傲的成員。請永遠昂首挺胸，並且...

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
^777777(Gai's voice fades out.)^000000.
I'm sorry I strangled you when we first met.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
^777777（蓋的聲音漸漸消失。）^000000
抱歉，我們第一次見面時我掐住了你的脖子。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Puhahaha! Gai is all talk. I know I was know valuable to you than that Gai.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
噗哈哈！蓋只會說大話。我知道我比那個蓋對你更有價值。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
I did some work on the prototype {0} you made.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
我對你製作的{0}原型做了一些加工。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
{0} now shines beautifully with a scarlet glow after I did the finishing touches.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
經過我的最後修飾，{0}現在閃耀著美麗的猩紅光芒。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
I named your weapons on my own but I know you'll like the name.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
我擅自給你的武器起了名字，但我相信你會喜歡的。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Leader Gion, please continue.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
首領 吉翁，請繼續。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I don't have much to add because Gai and Joe said it all.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
蓋和喬已經把話說完了，我沒什麼要補充的。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I'm just sorry that the environment of all these tests could have been better for our later generation.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
我只是很遺憾，這些測試的環境本可以更好，以便造福我們的後代。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You only need to look forward and never turn back.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
你只需要向前看，不要回頭。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I hope the blessings of Kagerou, dancing sun and Oboro, misty moonlight will be with you on your journey ahead.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
願影狼的祝福、舞動的太陽以及朧的朦朧月光，伴隨你前行的旅途。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I hope the blessings of Kagerou, dancing sun and Oboro, misty moonlight will be with you on your journey ahead.
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
願影狼的祝福、舞動的太陽以及朧的朦朧月光，伴隨你前行的旅途。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You should not be here. Please leave!
scripts.translation:
[首領 吉翁]
你不該在這裡。請離開！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Congratulation for choosing the road of development!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
祝賀你選擇了這條成長之路！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
You have not found the target? Continue searching it.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
還沒找到目標嗎？繼續尋找。

scripts.translation:
